name: Franke et al. 2020 (PMC7332772)
title: Energy Expenditure of Dynamic Submaximal Human Plantarflexion Movements: Model Prediction and Validation by in-vivo Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
verified_channels: 3D T1-weighted MRI gastrocnemius medialis volumetry (379.89 mL)
Dynamic 31P-MRS energy accumulation (11 points, TR=5 s, GM)
Kinematics and sEMG (normalized MVC, recorded outside magnet at 2 kHz, MAT file interpolated to 4 kHz)
role: Single-subject multi-modal anatomical MRI, dynamic 31P-MRS, and sEMG benchmark for active muscle volume and metabolic scaling
methodological_caveats: 3D MRI, sEMG+kinematics, and 31P-MRS were acquired in separate trials, not simultaneously.
Hardware sEMG acquisition was at 2000 Hz; 240,001 points in supplementary MAT file reflect 4 kHz upsampling / interpolation.
sEMG RMS (12.7%) is a normalized surface electrical amplitude, NOT an empirical measurement of recruited fiber fraction or active 3D muscle volume.

name: Edwards et al. 2013 (PMC3560356)
title: Integrating muscle cell biochemistry and whole-body physiology in humans: 31P-MRS data from the InSight trial
role: Empirical reference distribution for human skeletal muscle resting phosphagen concentrations and ratios across a large cohort (n=89)
first_author_note: Primary first author is Edwards, L. M. (Edwards et al., 2013; Caudwell Xtreme Everest InSight trial), not Sleigh et al.

name: Meyerspeer et al. 2021 (PMC8243949)
title: 31P magnetic resonance spectroscopy in skeletal muscle: Experts' consensus recommendations
verified_channels: Standardized 31P-MRS quantitation units and pH calculation
Creatine kinase equilibrium and free ADP estimation
Recommended reporting norms for resting metabolites and oxidative fluxes
role: International consensus standard for absolute 31P-MRS quantification, metabolite bounds, and thermodynamic calculation

name: Andersen & Saltin 1985 / Radegran & Saltin 1998
title: Maximal perfusion of skeletal muscle in man
verified_channels: Resting human femoral blood flow in quadriceps (2.0 - 3.5 mL/100g/min)
Arteriovenous oxygen difference (Ca - Cv)O2 (50 - 65 mL O2/L)
Resting quadriceps muscle VO2 (0.12 - 0.25 mL O2/100g/min = 0.006 - 0.015 mmol ATP/L/s)
role: Invasive human physiological gold standard for resting quadriceps skeletal muscle oxygen consumption (M_loc) and blood flow
provenance_caveat: Values (flow 2.4 mL/100g/min, (Ca - Cv)O2 = 58 mL/L, M_loc = 0.0064 mmol ATP/L/s) are invasive whole-quadriceps benchmarks during knee extension, NOT measured resting baseline for gastrocnemius medialis. Calf application is MODEL_ASSUMED_QUADRICEPS_TRANSFER.

name: Ryan et al. 2014 / McManus 2018 (MCMITO)
title: Non-invasive assessment of skeletal muscle mitochondrial capacity with near-infrared spectroscopy: arterial occlusion and scattering corrections
verified_channels: NIRS vascular occlusion test (VOT) recovery slopes
role: Methodological benchmark for NIRS vascular occlusion testing and analysis of uncalibrated gain/offset limitations for M_loc
